paper_title: The Role of Model Architecture and Scale in Predicting Molecular   Properties Insights from Fine-Tuning RoBERTa, BART, and LLaMA
caption: Training Loss vs. Steps for Each Model Type by Model Size with a Data Size of 20 millions. The loss trends for 10 million and 20 million datasets are similar.
model_annotation:
Here's a description of the line plot, following your instructions:

The plot illustrates the training loss over a series of steps for several Chem model variants. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 440,000, with tick labels at intervals of 80,000. The y-axis is labeled "Train Loss" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 0.85. A solid red line, labeled "ChemBART Small 20M," begins at approximately 0.76 and decreases to approximately 0.01 at the end of the x-axis. A dashed red line, labeled "ChemBART Medium 20M," begins at approximately 0.75 at the start and ends near 0.01. A dashed blue line, labeled "ChemBERTa Small 20M," begins at approximately 0.74 and ends at about 0.01. A dashed green line, labeled "ChemBERTa Medium 20M," starts at approximately 0.74 and finishes around 0.01. A dashed magenta line, labeled "ChemLLaMA Small 20M," starts at approximately 0.73 and ends at roughly 0.01. A solid black line, labeled "ChemLLaMA Medium 20M," begins at approximately 0.73 and ends at about 0.01. All lines exhibit a generally decreasing trend across the plotted step range, with fluctuations observed throughout.
